rationale: The plan identifies the design correctly as a 2x4 time course and tests the condition:time interaction with a DESeq2 LRT of ~condition+time+condition:time against ~condition+time, with time as a factor so no linearity is assumed, plus an edgeR QL joint test of all three interaction coefficients as an independent cross-check — exactly the reference approach, and it explains why a single Wald coefficient is insufficient. QC is concrete and design-aware (blind VST, PCA and distance heatmap annotated by condition and time, library sizes, per-cell replicate correlation, cell-count table, flag-not-remove policy). The filter (>=10 counts in >=3 samples, tied to the smallest cell) is minimal and justified; normalization stays inside DESeq2 size factors and edgeR TMM with an explicit prohibition on pre-scaling or cross-feeding normalized counts. Reference levels are set explicitly, BH at alpha=0.05 with alpha passed to results(), selection by padj only, apeglm shrinkage per interaction coefficient with unshrunken values retained, and NA-by-outlier vs NA-by-filtering reported separately. Enrichment is arguably optional here but is handled properly: full ranked list, an explicitly justified signed -log10 LRT p ranking, Hallmark with a 15-500 size window applied after intersection, tested genes as ORA universe, and a clean stop if no collection exists; the report step covers versions, design, thresholds, gene counts, overlap, and the n=3 power caveat.
